usage: 景觀 is used to talk about the view or scenery visible from a place, especially a property.
It's a noun and often comes after possessive markers, like '我嘅景觀' (my view).
You can describe the quality of the view using adjectives before 景觀, such as '靚景觀' (beautiful view).
The word can be combined with real estate terms to discuss property features, like '景觀樓' (building with a good view).
景觀 is also used to emphasize how the view affects the attractiveness or value of a place.
